body_html:
I lost my first response was a good poem. Will try again (not as good #poetryport #edu506)

Alchemy has not fallen
to our networked
world
while face to face
has its place
alchemist of
code, bards of blogs
no monologues
we are together
a guild of Griots
sing in digital spaces
plot paces
in digital laces
woven in webs
with
ebbs and flows
in transformation of
matter
a remix of the medium
like a mad hatter
in the tedium of
setting a digital home
